questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: Why is Karnataka regarded as a leading IT state in India?

options.B: It has a deep concentration of software companies, IT-enabled services, research institutions, technology parks, skilled professionals, start-ups and GCCs
options.C: It has the largest coastline in India

questions.explanation: Karnataka has a deep concentration of software companies, IT-enabled services, research institutions, technology parks, skilled professionals, start-ups and global capability centres (GCCs). Bengaluru is the principal centre, while Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad and other cities are being developed as additional technology destinations.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: Which city is popularly called the Silicon Valley of India?

options.B: Mangaluru

questions.explanation: Bengaluru is popularly called the Silicon Valley of India because of its concentration of software firms, technology talent, R&D centres, start-ups and technology-related exports.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: When did Karnataka's IT development begin to gain institutional momentum?

options.B: The 1960s
options.C: The 1980s with computerisation and electronics initiatives, STPI Bengaluru in 1992, and subsequent technology-park and policy initiatives

questions.explanation: The Karnataka Government's computerisation and electronics initiatives in the 1980s, the establishment of STPI's Bengaluru operations in 1992, and subsequent technology-park and policy initiatives helped accelerate the sector.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is STPI?

options.B: Software Technology Parks of India, an autonomous society under the Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

questions.explanation: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) is an autonomous society under the Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. It provides infrastructure and support for software exports, including statutory services relating to export certification.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is a Global Capability Centre (GCC)?

options.A: A government office for global trade
options.B: An offshore or global centre established by a multinational company to perform functions such as software development, engineering, analytics, finance, cybersecurity, research, design and business operations
options.C: A centre that only manufactures hardware

questions.explanation: A GCC is an offshore or global centre established by a multinational company to perform functions such as software development, engineering, analytics, finance, cybersecurity, research, design and business operations.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: Which of the following are major IT-related activities in Karnataka?

options.B: Software product development, IT services, IT-enabled services, BPM, cloud computing, AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, fintech, engineering R&D and digital platforms

questions.explanation: Karnataka's major IT-related activities include software product development, IT services, IT-enabled services, business-process management, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cybersecurity, fintech, engineering R&D and digital platforms.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is the importance of IT exports to Karnataka?

options.B: They bring external income, support high-skilled employment, attract foreign investment, strengthen service-sector growth and create demand for education, housing, transport and professional services
options.D: They have no effect on employment

questions.explanation: IT exports bring external income into the State, support high-skilled employment, attract foreign investment, strengthen service-sector growth and create demand for education, housing, transport and professional services.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is the Beyond Bengaluru approach?

options.A: A policy to concentrate all IT investment in Bengaluru
options.B: A policy approach to spread technology-sector investment, jobs and innovation beyond Bengaluru to other cities and regions
options.C: A policy to stop IT exports
options.D: A policy to move IT companies abroad

questions.explanation: Beyond Bengaluru is a policy approach to spread technology-sector investment, jobs and innovation beyond Bengaluru to other cities and regions, helping reduce geographic concentration and promote balanced development.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is the Karnataka IT Policy 2025-30 intended to achieve?

options.B: Strengthen the technology ecosystem, promote emerging technologies, expand exports and jobs, encourage investment outside Bengaluru and support innovation and digital infrastructure

questions.explanation: The Karnataka IT Policy 2025-30 aims to strengthen the State's technology ecosystem, promote emerging technologies, expand exports and jobs, encourage investment outside Bengaluru and support innovation and digital infrastructure.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What IT-sector figure was highlighted by the Karnataka Government in the 2026 budget communication?

options.B: About 25% of India's IT exports

questions.explanation: The Government stated that Karnataka accounts for about 43% of India's IT exports. This is a government-reported share and the source and reference period should be retained when quoting it.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is one important limitation of Karnataka's IT-led growth?

questions.explanation: IT activity and high-value jobs are geographically concentrated, especially in Bengaluru. The State must address congestion, housing costs, infrastructure pressure, skill gaps and regional inequality.

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
questions.question: What is biotechnology?

options.A: The study of rocks and minerals

questions.subject: Karnataka Economy
